-- VR SCENES (AX5)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vr_scenes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  scene_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  era VARCHAR(100),
  location VARCHAR(255),
  assets JSON,
  scent_cues JSON,
  hardware VARCHAR(255),
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX5_IMMERSIVE_DEMOCRAT',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- CITIZEN OBSERVATIONS (AX5)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS citizen_observations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  obs_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_handle VARCHAR(100),
  plant_guess VARCHAR(255),
  lat DECIMAL(10,6),
  lon DECIMAL(10,6),
  obs_date DATE,
  photo_url VARCHAR(500),
  confidence_ai DECIMAL(3,2),
  status ENUM('submitted', 'pending_review', 'verified', 'rejected') DEFAULT 'submitted',
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX5_IMMERSIVE_DEMOCRAT',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX co_status_idx (status)
);
